response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, CAST(execution_count AS REAL) / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), results AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_difference FROM results ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
